articles.summary: WESTFIELD, Mass., Jan. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Western New England Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company” or “WNEB”) (NasdaqGS: WNEB), the holding company for Westfield Bank (the “Bank”), announced today the unaudited results of operations for the three and twelve months ended December 31, 2025.
